lines.en: - Would you want to do the honors?
- Oh, right, you know, I don't think we have to do this.
- We shroots don't need some Harvard doctor
to tell us who's alive and who's dead.
But there was an unlucky streak
and when grave robbers discovered some scratch marks
on the inside of some of the coffins,
we decided to make sure that our dead were completely dead,
